about_the_game:
Game Story

"Whatever you uncover, whatever you choose to remember...
know that I have always loved you.
Even when I couldn’t say it.

And above all, remember this:
You will never be alone."

A Lighthouse Tale is a single-player narrative adventure set on a remote island, dominated by an old lighthouse and wrapped in memories of the past. After years of silence, you receive a letter from your late grandfather—a final testament asking you to return to the place you haven't visited since childhood.

Explore the island you've inherited and uncover the secrets and stories it holds. Through simple puzzles, interactive moments, and fragmented memories, you'll relive forgotten emotions and try to understand why your grandfather was so determined for you to return… and what, exactly, he wanted you to find there.

Features

  • Live a deep, personal narrative adventure

  • Explore an island filled with history, emotion, and mystery

  • Solve environmental puzzles to unlock fragments of the past

  • Find hidden collectibles across the island to relive additional memories

  • Immerse yourself in an intimate story of memory and self-discovery

Minimum:
  • OS *: windows 7 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380 (2 GB VRAM minimums)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
